title: Realize conflict-free, broadcast, and n-way shared-memory access patterns (CUDA)
info: one warp (32 threads), one __shared__ buffer per launch; each of the 3 cases relaunches the same kernel with a different case_id
smem_waves counts a write step and a read-back step, so a conflict-free/broadcast case reads 2, a 4-way conflict reads 8
the simulator executes a block's threads in tid order within each phase, so a broadcast write's surviving value is deterministically thread 31's (the last writer), not thread 0's
